fit.sheet: TI LM833 data sheet SLOS481B (revised October 2014), at ±15 V
fit.figure: Electrical characteristics at ±15 V: AVD 110 dB typ, unity-gain frequency 9 MHz (GBW 16 MHz at 100 kHz), slew rate 7 V/µs, phase margin 55°, open-loop output impedance 37 Ω, 2.05 mA per channel, VOM 14.1 / −14.6 V typ at 10 kΩ
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. Output resistance the sheet's 37 Ω, clamps 0.85 V under V+ and 0.35 V over V− so the 10 kΩ swing lands on the typical (simulated 0.87 and 0.37 V). Checked: slews at 6.87 V/µs.
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ).
